page.title: Kite Desk: AI WhatsApp receptionist (early access) | Kitebuild Studio
page.desc: Kite Desk by Kitebuild Studio: an AI WhatsApp receptionist for small businesses. In development, early access.
page.eyebrow: Kite Desk · In development · Early access
page.lead: An AI WhatsApp receptionist for small businesses. It answers common questions, takes bookings, and hands the chat to a human when needed.
page.step1: Set up. We load your hours, services, prices and FAQs into a simple config.
page.step2: Connect. Kite Desk is connected to your WhatsApp Business number via the WhatsApp Cloud API.
page.step3: Reply. Customers get instant answers and bookings; anything tricky is handed to your team.
page.f1p: Hours, prices, location and policies, answered from your own business info.
page.f2p: Collects name, service and preferred time, then confirms back to the customer.
page.f3p: Customers can ask for a person at any time; your team takes over the chat.
page.f4p: Business info lives in a config file you can review and update.
page.demo_sub: Demo, sample business: “{biz}” is fictional. This demo is rule-based, runs only in your browser, and sends no real WhatsApp messages. It is not connected to WhatsApp.
page.pricing_p: Kite Desk is in development. Get in touch to join early access and discuss your business.
page.q1: Is Kite Desk live on WhatsApp?
page.a1: Not yet. Kite Desk is in development and offered as early access. The demo above runs only in your browser.
page.a2: Small businesses that get repeat questions and bookings on WhatsApp: salons, clinics, studios, workshops.
page.q3: Can a real person take over?
page.a3: Yes. Handoff to a human is a core feature.
page.int_btn: Request early access via our contact form
page.foot: © Kitebuild Studio, Dubai · Kite Desk is in development. Demo uses a fictional sample business.

msg.welcome: Hi! 👋 Welcome to {biz}. Ask about hours, prices, location, say 'book' to make an appointment, or 'talk to a human'.
msg.greet: Hi! 👋 Welcome to {biz}. I can share hours, prices, location, book an appointment, or connect you to a human.
msg.handoff: No problem — I’m handing you to a team member at {biz}. Someone will reply here shortly. (Demo: no real person is notified.)
msg.cancelled: Booking cancelled. Anything else I can help with?
msg.ask_name: Happy to book you in! What’s your name?
msg.ask_service:
Thanks {name}! Which service would you like?
{list}
msg.not_caught:
Sorry, I didn’t catch that. Please pick one:
{list}
msg.ask_time: Great, {service} ({price}). What day and time suits you? e.g. 'Saturday 4pm'
msg.booked: ✅ Booked! {name}, your {service} is confirmed for {time} at {biz}. (Demo booking, nothing was actually reserved.)
msg.restart: No problem, let’s start again. What’s your name?
msg.fallback: I can help with: opening hours, prices, location, booking an appointment, or 'talk to a human'.
